hooks.command: changed=$(cat | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$changed" in *secure_rls/security/*|*/db.py|db.py) echo 'Security layer touched - running the isolation tests'; python -m pytest -q -m 'not slow' tests/test_isolation.py tests/test_sql_guard.py tests/test_egress.py ;; esac
